text:
Harper: heads up — post-deploy telemetry shows embedding top-10 recall drop for a small customer cohort in EU
Juan: saw the alert, which version?
Harper: embeddings 4.0.0 rolled at 07:30 UTC. drift ~7% on their queries
deploy-bot: [alert] model-quality-regression detected embeddings:4.0.0. Autopilot rollback suppressed due to change-window policy (08:00-12:00 UTC)
Kevin: that means manual decision. Are dedicated pools impacted or just hosted?
Harper: hosted only, but it's a paying pilot. risk of churn if we don't act
Lia: recommend scoped rollback: pin the affected customer route to embeddings:3.9.5 while leaving general traffic on 4.0.0. less risky than full rollback
Juan: agree. can we do per-route override? yes — redwood supports route-level model pins
Harper: running commands:
Harper: ```
redwoodctl model pin embeddings --version 3.9.5 --scope route:acct-42
redwoodctl route set acct-42-search --model embeddings:3.9.5 --force
```
deploy-bot: [action] pin requested by Harper. executing partial pin for route acct-42. ETA 6m
Kevin: drafting customer message: "We've observed degraded similarity for some queries after our recent model update. We've routed your search traffic to the previous model while we investigate."
Lia: i will monitor metrics and open a follow-up ticket to fix tokenizer changes in 4.0.0
deploy-bot: [success] route-level pin complete. Observability: acct-42 synthetic checks returned to baseline
Harper: filing postmortem item: release notes missed backward-compatibility note; also change-window policy suppressed autopilot. propose an exception flow for high-severity quality regressions
Juan: noted. will add to incident backlog. thanks team
Kevin: customer notified. closing thread.
